All nine criteria are graded below. Criteria 1–7 and 9 rest on the engine's deterministic check findings. Criterion 8 I graded myself, against the spec behaviours.

For criterion 8, I opened `phase-coding.spec.md` around PHC-B16 to PHC-B19 and its acceptance lines. I also read the acceptance lines of `session-record-checks.spec.md` and `visit-session-record.spec.md`. I did not open the full bodies of SRC-B5, SRC-B8, SRC-B9, SRC-B11, SRC-B12, VSR-B1 and VSR-B2. For those I relied on the heading and acceptance lines the search returned, so confidence is slightly below 1.0. Each of R1–R11 matches a behaviour or acceptance line, and none contradicts one.

| R3, R4 | PHC-B18 | "grade `ts-phs-scope` on the paths changed since the phase step was entered" |
| R5 | PHC-AC20 | "each phase gate passes with no pause" |
| R6 | PHC-B19 | "counted from the commit at which the code step was entered" |

| R9 | SRC-B12 | SRC-AC16 |
| R10 | SRC-B11 | SRC-AC15 |
| R11 | SRC-B5 | SRC-AC14 |

The plan's open-question default, option (a), agrees with PHC-B16's second example. There, both files are in the first list for the second phase (`phase-coding.spec.md:131`).
